DOCUMENT COLLECTION / LOCAL DEMO

Dossier Compleet · office dashboard · mock scenario

Document workflow

Dossier Compleet

From missing paperwork to a clear next step.

Problem
Document requests get scattered across inboxes. Missing items and uncertain uploads need a visible owner.
Solution
A client portal and office dashboard with explicit checks, human review, reminders and a local mail outbox.
Tech
Python · SQLite · HTML / CSS / JavaScript
Result
A working local workflow with tested rules. The default demo uses mock extraction fields; it makes no claim about AI accuracy or client results.
Explore the source ↗ for Dossier Compleet
LEAD INTAKE / LOCAL DEMO

LeadFlow · CRM dashboard · mock webhook transport

Intake & follow-up

LeadFlow

A submitted form should not become a lost task.

Problem
An intake app needs reliable follow-up when delivery fails or the same request arrives more than once.
Solution
A CRM backed by a durable event outbox, retries and idempotent processing. Manual follow-up stays separate from automation.
Tech
FastAPI · SQLite · Next.js · TypeScript · optional n8n
Result
A tested local pipeline with an offline mock-webhook demo. Priority uses fixed rules; live n8n and production deployment are separate next steps.

I’m in my first year of Artificial Intelligence at Vrije Universiteit Amsterdam. I learn by building web and automation projects, testing their behavior, and documenting what I would improve next.

My current tools include Python, FastAPI, SQLite, JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Next.js and Git. I build with an AI coding assistant: I decide what a project should do, then read, run and test what we produce. Each README explains how it works, what is simulated and what I would improve next.
